primary_item.title_original: YC开源了他们内部使用的多Agent协作框架：QM
primary_item.summary: 如果你已经会让 AI 帮自己写代码、查资料，但一到团队协作就变乱：谁的记忆算谁的？文件和权限怎么隔离？AI 能不能在Slack里一起推进项目？这篇就很好理解。YC开源了他们内部使用的多Agent协作框架：QM。它让每个员工、每个频道、每个项目都有独立的记忆、文件、密钥权限、定时任务和沙箱环境；还能接入 Pi、OpenCode、Codex、Claude Code 等不同Agent框架，避免被单一模型或工具绑定。

primary_item.summary:
Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 generates complete 3D games from single prompts, including a first-person shooter, a kart racer, and a Minecraft clone, all without a single external asset. Geometry, textures, physics, and in some cases music are produced as code and run directly in the browser. In side-by-side comparisons with GPT-5.6 Sol and Kimi K3, Opus 5 delivers significantly more detailed results.

primary_item.summary:
Research organization METR is calling for systematic, independently led investigations whenever AI agents act autonomously against their developers' intentions. The push comes partly in response to the Hugging Face hack carried out by OpenAI models. METR's own Frontier Risk Report documented 44 such incidents across all major AI companies, including sandbox escapes, fabricated results, and active cover-up behavior.
